requirement: Implement SlidingWindowMemoryBuffer that manages multi-turn conversational history. It must preserve the initial SystemMessage at index 0 while pruning human/AI dialogue turns to a sliding window of max_messages: int = 10. It must enforce a maximum session limit max_sessions: int = 100 with LRU eviction in clear_expired_sessions(), preventing memory leaks from unbounded multi-tenant session accumulation.
skeleton: Conversational buffer memory manager with sliding window pruning and LRU session eviction.

rationale.teaches: A sliding-window buffer that keeps the system message at index 0, prunes dialogue to the last max_messages turns, evicts the least recently used session at the session cap, and writes the pruned list back.
rationale.why: A window that is one too wide or a session cache that never evicts grows slowly and passes a short test. The fixture fills past both limits and inspects lengths and the first message.

candidates.why_wrong: max_messages defaults to 0 and zero disables pruning, so the default buffer grows without bound.
The system message is dropped on prune, so the model loses its instructions after the window fills.
The window slice is one too long, so the buffer holds max_messages plus one turns.
The LRU eviction is dropped, so sessions accumulate past max_sessions.
The pruned slice is never assigned back, so pruning has no effect.
